name: Goodyear welting
summary: A way to sew a strip of leather, the welt, to the upper and the insole rib, and then to stitch the sole to the welt.
how: Sew the welt to the upper and to the rib of the insole.
Fill the gap under the insole with cork.
Stitch the outsole to the welt, so that a cobbler can replace it.

origin.note: Charles Goodyear Jr. builds a machine that sews the welt.

adoptions.via: English makers in Northampton take the machine, and it sets the standard of the welted dress shoe.
The eight-eye workboot uses a welted sole with a yellow thread.
